matches.hypothesis: One indicator shared across all seven decoder stages couples confidence fitting for different refinement states. Independent stage-specific indicator heads may let the final head fit its own mask/query distribution without intermediate-stage head-gradient interference. This is a structural training comparison, not an efficacy claim.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged AdaRES-W2 native YAML and all seven confidence losses. Clone the initial head for every refinement stage without consuming RNG; keep point-mass competition, masks, selector, targets, optimizer, seed1999 and fixed30.

matches.hypothesis: W2 row-normalized peer context and maximum overlap need not retain the total overlap strength of distinct competitors. A separate mean off-diagonal point-mass IoU density input may supply that missing scalar evidence to confidence. Utility is unmeasured.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 head plus density times a zero-initialized two-logit weight; no added RNG, thresholds, feature selection, loss/selector changes or density scale search. Keep all seven shared-head losses, released SPFormer, seed1999 and fixed30.

The original MLP can represent interactions implicitly; this is an architectural optimization comparison, not a missing-information or efficacy claim.
